summary: Iter-14: Full backend + frontend validation of (a) sales edit (PUT /api/sales/{id}): veresiye↔nakit toggling preserves created_by, adds updated_at/updated_by_name, deletes old income or cari_tx and creates the new one; qty increase up to (current_stock + old_sale_qty) succeeds, exceeding returns 400; product swap restores old tire stock and decrements new tire; 404 on missing id. (b) sales delete (DELETE /api/sales/{id}): record fully removed (GET /api/sales/{id} 404, not in list), stock reverted via 'iade' movement, income or cari_tx removed. (c) 'Diğer' product via POST/PUT /api/tires with product_type='diger': name required (400 if missing), lastik still requires brand+size (400 if missing), label = 'Ad Marka Model (Kategori)' verified, can be sold mixed with lastik and reduces stock, /dashboard/overview stock.critical row contains product_type/name/category/unit/label; threshold applies to diğer. (d) FIFO oldest open debt: GET /api/cariler and /api/cariler/{id} return oldest_open_date & open_days; scenario 3000(09-01)+1000(09-20)-3000(09-25)=1000 → oldest=09-20 open_days=22; partial 1000 → oldest=09-01 open_days=41; fully paid → both null; /dashboard/overview receivables.items include same fields. Backend tests: 18/18 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_sales_edit_delete_other.py. Frontend (Playwright, murat): login OK; dashboard renders receivables-summary + stock-summary (0 open receivables → no receivable-age cards, matches live data); /stok page title is 'Stok', nav-stok label is 'Stok'; tire-add-btn opens dropdown with stock-add-tire ('Lastik Stok standart') and stock-add-other ('Diğer'); Diğer form shows all 10 required test-ids (other-form-name/category/unit/brand/model + tire-form-qty/buy/sell/kdv/save); created a TEST_UIDIG diğer product → appeared in table with category 'Jant' → stock-type-{all,lastik,diger} filter buttons work → deleted successfully via tire-delete-{id}; /satislar page shows sale-count=0, sale-total-ciro=₺0,00, sale-veresiye-total=₺0,00 (no sales in DB); /cariler shows 'En Eski Açık Borç' column header and cari-oldest-{id} cell (empty '—' because the only real cari 'Test Oto' has 0 remaining alacak). No real data (Michelin Primacy 4 tire qty=10, Test Oto cari) was created/modified/deleted; all test data was prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — _oldest_open_debt uses `left < -0.005` to detect the first non-fully-consumed alacak. Works but is confusing; a cleaner formulation would iterate sorted alacaks subtracting cumulative payments and return the first alacak whose cumulative_sum > total_payment. Current algorithm has one subtle quirk: the ordering key is `(date, created_at)` but transactions with the same date and different real-world ordering (e.g. two alacaks created the same day) will FIFO by DB insert time — fine for 99% of cases, document it.

server.py GET /api/incomes response does not expose `sale_id` even though the field is stored in db.incomes — tests had to key on description/amount/date. Consider surfacing sale_id in the GET /api/incomes payload for easier audit/traceability.

server.py — PUT /api/sales/{sale_id} fallback (`except HTTPException: await db.sales.delete_one(...)`) actually DELETES the sale when the re-apply fails after already reverting old effects. This permanently loses the sale (stock/income/cari already reverted). The 400 message says 'satış geri alındı … Lütfen satışı yeniden girin' which is honest, but in practice this is a soft data loss. Consider restoring the OLD sale doc instead (we have `old` in scope) so the user doesn't lose history.
server.py has grown to 3009 lines (+56 since iter-13). Sales/Tires/Cariler routers would move cleanly into separate modules. (Repeat of previous iterations' recommendation.)

_revert_sale_effects deletes income/cari_tx silently. Since sale deletion is now permanent (not pasif), it may be useful to also log the reversed amount in an audit trail collection (today only log_activity captures a text line).
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ prefixed data (tires, cariler, sales, cari transactions) created inside the test module is deleted via module-scope teardown. Deletion order: sales → tires → cariler (so stock/cari_tx revert correctly). One UI-created TEST_UIDIG diger product was also deleted via the UI during Playwright run. Michelin Primacy 4 qty=10 and 'Test Oto' cari were NOT touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<prod_url> pytest -o addopts= /app/backend/tests/test_sales_edit_delete_other.py -v --tb=short`. Module-scope cleanup. Hard-coded TODAY=2026-10-12 is used for open_days arithmetic — if the container clock drifts out of 2026-10-12 UTC, the two assertions `open_days==22` (test_fifo_full_payment_moves_to_next) and `open_days==41` (test_fifo_partial_payment) and `open_days==11` (test_cariler_list_has_oldest_fields) will need to be adjusted. All overview-related tests pass start/end params explicitly. Prior iter-13 (dashboard v2, 17/17 PASS) still green conceptually — not re-run this iter. The POST /api/cariler/{id}/transactions endpoint accepts date as YYYY-MM-DD; FIFO ordering uses (date, created_at).
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Implementation of the three requested features (sales edit/delete, 'Stok' rename + Diğer product, FIFO oldest open debt) matches spec exactly across backend endpoints, data models, and UI test-ids.
